question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**minimum**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context tells us that "Folk football" matches have been played in cities and villages since pre-medieval times, following local traditions and with a few basic guidelines.
 
• "**Minimum**" (न्यूनतम) fits well as it denotes the basic rules which were followed back then.
 
• Other options ("**optimum**", "**variance**", "**maximum**") do not fit the context of describing the impact of forest fires on forests and biodiversity.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Optimum (सर्वोत्तम):** "Optimum" means the most favorable condition, which does not fit the context of discussing forest fire hazards.
 
• **Variance (विचलन): **"Variance" means the fact or quality of being different, which does not reflect the idea of danger or harm.
 
• **Maximum (अधिकतम):** "Maximum" means the greatest amount, which does not align with describing the risk posed by forest fires.
